campaignsText: Vault 7/8's campaign involved systematic leaks through WikiLeaks, with weekly disclosures starting in March 2017. The disclosures targeted the CIA's cyber capabilities, affecting global tech companies. Notable operations include exposure of tools targeting iPhones, Android devices, and Samsung TVs.
description: Vault 7/8, a former CIA software engineer, emerged as a significant threat actor through their leak of over 10,000 classified documents from March 2017 to 2018 via WikiLeaks. These leaks exposed numerous zero-day vulnerabilities and tools, profoundly impacting global cybersecurity by enabling other actors to exploit these weaknesses.
